applicability: CORE or Marketplace Portal accounts with the corresponding optional product records, service profile 4.1.0. Existing base product rules apply alongside these additional terms.
content:
MARGIN cover protects a principal amount one thousand times the USD-cent deposit. The deposit competes with application and remittance charges for the same fee wallet until the covered payment settles and release is requested. A deposit is not an extra principal reserve.

Detailed local effects and operation names: `RST-fee-guarantee`.

provenance.source: Primary-author synthetic extension of the frozen 4.0.2 business mechanisms; no claim of a verbatim source SOP rule.
